summary.p25_q1_implication: The evaluation model based on the existing 4D R_t dynamics exhibits basic relational persistence without requiring an additional state representation. Harness evidence must be clearly distinguished from production-runtime evidence: while the evaluation harness demonstrates persistence under controlled simulation, production RelationshipState is NOT proven sufficient for all relational persistence. Unresolved questions remain whether (A) R_t alone may be sufficient, (B) R_t + existing memory/semantic substrate may be sufficient, or (C) a new computational representation may be necessary. No option is ratified. Status remains INCONCLUSIVE — MORE RESEARCH REQUIRED.
